verdict.rationale: Datadog documents a first-party Dashboards product. Community reports say non-developers can build dashboards, widgets move between dashboards and notebooks, and view state lives in the URL so views are easy to share. Distinctive visualizations such as the hexagon host map are praised. Missing for 10: any evidence of template variables, detail on the range of visualization and widget types, explicit dashboard sharing or permissions documentation, and dashboards-as-code (API/Terraform) evidence specific to dashboards.
